scope: HTTP endpoints for all 97 planned PHASE_01 operations + 2 new (stepUpMfa, bootstrapSelfApproveRequest) over the 01.3 services: auth/MFA/sessions, me, users, roles/assignments, org tree/units/positions/holders, tasks, approvals, workflow definitions/instances, audit query/integrity, health detail, jobs + safe cancel, documents (quarantined upload, attachment-only download), parameters, dynamic-field drafts

production ACCESS_POLICY = RbacPolicy (approved matrix v1.0) instead of DenyAllPolicy; deny by default kept (unknown action 403, out of scope 404); public operations = probes + getLoginContext + login
session-cookie authentication (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure outside dev/test), CSRF on login and on every unsafe session request, MFA step-up enforced from the permission's DB flag
SEC-01: 404 for out-of-scope ids on every {id} path family (50 families, all methods), lists filtered with the same rule
SEC-03: multipart upload -> 413/415/QUARANTINED 202, download CLEAN only (409), attachment + octet-stream + nosniff + sandbox CSP, audited

rate limits: existing anon/principal + login per IP and per username (technical defaults); ETag/If-Match (428/412/400) with scope checked before version; cursor pagination; X-Request-ID into audit/outbox; Idempotency-Key on every non-ceremony write (C-27 exemptions incl. stepUpMfa); one-time passwords never stored in idempotency records
DEC-055 contract item: separate operation POST /workflow/approvals/{approval_id}/bootstrap-approve
requestJobCancel OpenAPI text aligned with STATE_TRANSITIONS 4.7 (QUEUED -> CANCELLED)

test_evidence.command: ruff check backend tools && ruff format --check backend tools
pytest -m "not perf" --junitxml (1846 passed, 1 skipped: real-ClamAV contract test, clamd not reachable)
race tests -k "concurrent or race or parallel" x3 (25 passed each run, incl. 4 new HTTP race tests)

security_evidence: SEC-01: test_api_bola.py - probe with ALL permissions scoped ORG_UNIT=A gets 404 NOT_FOUND on every {id} operation of the contract (50 path families, reads and writes with valid body, Idempotency-Key and current If-Match); GLOBAL holder reads the same ids (200); lists == object checks; subtree scope; revision under another document's path -> 404

deny by default: authenticated principal without grants -> 403 on every route (test_authz_route_parity), employee session -> 403 on every operation of a permission the matrix does not give it (test_api_phase01_contract)

SEC-03: exe / xlsm / magic mismatch -> 415, size -> 413, QUARANTINED -> download 409, CLEAN -> attachment + application/octet-stream + nosniff + sandbox CSP, download audited, subprocess/os.system patched to fail
CSRF on login and unsafe session requests (403); session cookie HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax (+Secure in staging/prod by settings); token rotated at MFA verification
MFA step-up enforced from the permission's DB flag (401 MFA_REQUIRED, stepUpMfa); contract flags == approved catalogue flags (test)
one-time passwords shown once, idempotency record and replay carry [REDACTED]
login throttles per IP and per username (hashed key) -> 429 RATE_LIMITED + Retry-After
X-Request-ID propagated into audit and outbox rows of the write
risks: owner_admin holds no platform.workflow.approval.read (matrix v1.0): the owner cannot read his own pending requests (needed for the If-Match of bootstrap-approve; a fresh request is version 1) - employer question
login throttle defaults 20/min per IP and 10/min per username are TECHNICAL DEFAULTS, not approved values
not supported yet (400 NOT_SUPPORTED): assignment valid_from, org valid_from/effective_from/as_of other than now, task reassignment to unit/position, ENUM parameter definitions

upload: encrypted bytes written before the transaction; if the outer idempotent transaction rolls back after the service committed its savepoint, an orphan stored object can remain (bytes only, no row)
task/approval inboxes filter per record (max 1000 rows inspected per page request) - perf check in 01.7
a user has at most 3 live sessions (Q-0101); a 4th browser login ends the oldest
rollback: no migration; revert the commit (the policy returns to DenyAllPolicy and the PHASE_01 routes disappear; contract back to 0.5.2-draft)
